claims.statement: The S3-compatible public service endpoint format is https://s3.oss-{region}.aliyuncs.com.
claims.conditions: Replace region with an actual OSS region ID; this does not override the separate Chinese-mainland default-public policy gate.

claims.statement: The S3-compatible internal endpoint format is https://s3.oss-{region}-internal.aliyuncs.com.
claims.conditions: Eligible only from the corresponding Alibaba Cloud VPC/network; it is a separate network contract.

claims.statement: The official AWS SDK examples disable path-style access or select virtual addressing for the S3-compatible endpoint.
claims.conditions: Candidate default only; CNAME endpoints use a distinct bucket-bound contract.

claims.statement: OSS documents support for the AWS Signature V4 algorithm on this compatibility surface.
claims.conditions: Algorithm support does not prove this implementation's exact canonical request or any operation.

claims.statement: The documented V4 compatibility request uses canonical payload literal UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD and x-oss-content-sha256: UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD.
claims.conditions: This is the candidate's unsigned fixed-length profile, not live evidence.

claims.statement: The documented compatibility request must not use Transfer-Encoding: chunked; official examples disable AWS SDK chunked encoding.
claims.conditions: The candidate therefore rejects Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Content-Encoding: aws-chunked, and AWS streaming payload literals.

claims.statement: The candidate requires a known Content-Length to produce deterministic non-chunked request framing.
claims.conditions: The source forbids chunked transfer but does not separately state that every compatible client must emit a Content-Length header.

claims.statement: Using the generic S3 ordinary payload SHA-256 and x-amz-content-sha256 instead of the documented OSS unsigned profile may work.
claims.conditions: Separate test-only wire profile; no automatic fallback after an ambiguous mutation.

claims.statement: For affected newer accounts, Chinese-mainland default public endpoints reject data API calls with PublicEndpointForbidden; official solutions are an eligible internal endpoint or a bucket-bound custom domain.
claims.conditions: Account activation date is evidence context, not a configuration bypass; the explicit preset is experimental and known OSS hosts cannot inherit the custom baseline.

claims.statement: The official matrix lists Put, HEAD, GET, Delete and core multipart API names. One bounded permanent-credential run confirmed the exact cn-beijing dual-header Put and query presign profile, but no release-qualified permanent/temporary matrix exists; conditional writes, metadata, observers and broader applicability remain unverified.
claims.conditions: Normal Put/presign are explicitly experimental; the bounded run was privilege-unknown and release-ineligible, and advanced operations remain test-only pending authorized release evidence.

claims.statement: The third-party S3-compatible application service address is https://cos.{region}.myqcloud.com.
claims.conditions: This is the S3 compatibility service address, not a claim that it is COS's only endpoint or the native SDK default.

claims.statement: COS bucket identity is the complete BucketName-APPID value; APPID is not inferred from credentials.
claims.conditions: The candidate requires the complete identity as input before constructing a virtual host.

claims.statement: Combining the complete bucket identity with the documented S3 service address in virtual-hosted style yields https://<BucketName-APPID>.cos.{region}.myqcloud.com.
claims.conditions: Candidate construction only; the native Java SDK uses its own endpoint builder and is not used to derive this S3 host.

claims.statement: The S3 compatibility guide says buckets created after 2024-01-01 do not support path-style domains.
claims.conditions: The candidate never generates path-style requests for COS, regardless of bucket creation date.

claims.statement: The S3 compatibility guide documents support for AWS V2 and AWS V4 signature formats.
claims.conditions: Format support is not proof of this implementation's exact AWS SigV4 canonicalization.

claims.statement: The generic signer used here produces the exact V4 canonical request accepted by COS for this service address.
claims.conditions: Offline vector only; no COS key or remote execution was available.

claims.statement: Tencent Cloud does not guarantee complete Amazon S3 compatibility.
claims.conditions: No result from AWS, OSS, or a different COS endpoint enables this contract.

claims.statement: The official AWS SDK guide demonstrates PutObject and STS and requires disabling x-amz-trailer, but exact payload hashing, query presign and all other operations remain unverified for this implementation.
claims.conditions: Normal Put/presign are explicitly experimental; advanced operations remain test-only and no COS credential was available.
